title: Exactness and shift compatibility for the external Hom thick reduction
statement:
Fix the finite-field and finite-coefficient datum of [def-trf-admissibility], so \(k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q\), \(\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k\), \(A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\) for a finite extension \(E/\mathbf Q_\ell\) and \(n\geq1\). Let \(X_1,X_2\) be separated finite-type \(k\)-schemes and fix \(L_i\in D^b_{ctf}(X_i,A)\). Use the derived operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and external products and the evaluation-defined comparison \(\beta\) of [def-sf-kv-maps]. Define bifunctors, contravariant in both variables, by
\[
 B(E_1,E_2)=R\mathcal Hom_A(E_1,L_1)\boxtimes_A^L R\mathcal Hom_A(E_2,L_2),\qquad
 T(E_1,E_2)=R\mathcal Hom_A(E_1\boxtimes_A^L E_2,L_1\boxtimes_A^L L_2).
\]
They take values in \(D^b_{ctf}(X_1\times_kX_2,A)\). For each fixed \(E_2\), \(B(-,E_2)\) and \(T(-,E_2)\) are exact functors from the opposite triangulated category \(D^b_{ctf}(X_1,A)^{\mathrm{op}}\); the analogous assertion holds with the two variables exchanged. The natural transformation \(\beta:B\to T\) is compatible with their canonical shift isomorphisms in each variable: if \(c_{B,i,m}:B(E_i[m],E_j)\xrightarrow{\sim}B(E_i,E_j)[-m]\) and \(c_{T,i,m}\) denote these comparisons (with the variables in their original order), then for every \(m\in\mathbf Z\),
\[
 c_{T,i,m}\circ\beta(E_i[m],E_j)=\beta(E_i,E_j)[-m]\circ c_{B,i,m}.
\]
The triangulated structures and exactness have the meaning of [def-weil-triangulated-category]; the comparisons include the tensor symmetry with its Koszul signs.
